# Security Policy

## Scope and current status

HASM is currently in an early stage of development. The repository is being developed intentionally and step by step, and external review or contribution is not currently open.

## Supported versions

Security fixes are provided for the latest version on the default branch as the project continues to evolve. Because the project is still maturing, compatibility and stability may change quickly between revisions.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Security issues are not currently accepted through public or private reporting channels.

At this time, the maintainer is not accepting vulnerability reports from outside the project. Please do not submit reports through GitHub Issues, the repository Security tab, or direct contact channels while the project remains in its early development stage.

This policy may be revisited in the future as the project matures and broader collaboration becomes appropriate.
